name: tickbench
description: Backtest Pine Script, MQL4/MQL5, Python, JavaScript, Tradovate and no-code strategies on your desktop.
author: Tickbench

scripts.dev:electron: tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json && wait-on tcp:5173 && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://localhost:5173 electron .
scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && vite build
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && electron-builder --win nsis --publish never
scripts.release:win: npm run build && electron-builder --win nsis --publish always
